meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成 GitHub PR 的代码讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要向同事或客户解释代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Turn a GitHub PR into a code-change explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain code changes to non-technical stakeholders

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会读取你给的 GitHub PR（链接、owner/repo#N 或当前仓库里的“这个 PR”），分析代码改动，产出脚本、逐帧画面和最终 mp4 视频。固定用“代码编辑”风格，不抓取网页。
howto.when: 当你给出一个 GitHub PR（链接、owner/repo#N 或当前仓库里的“this PR”）并要求做成视频时触发。意图不明确时先进 /hyperframes。

say.text: 给 owner/repo#456 的改动做 changelog 视频。
say.note: 按 PR 变更生成解说视频。

say.text: 当前仓库里这个 PR，做成修复说明视频。
say.note: 读取当前检出仓库的 PR 并制作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reads the GitHub PR you provide (URL, owner/repo#N, or "this PR" in a checked-out repo), analyzes the code change, and produces a script, per-frame visuals, and a final mp4 video. Fixed code-editorial style, no web capture.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give a GitHub PR (URL, owner/repo#N, or "this PR" in a checked-out repo) and ask for a video. Unclear intent routes to /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Make a one-minute video from https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123.
say_en.note: Starts reading the PR and building storyboard and video.

say_en.text: Make a changelog video for owner/repo#456.
say_en.note: Produces an explainer from that PR's change.

say_en.text: Make a fix-explainer video for this PR in the current repo.
say_en.note: Reads the checked-out PR and creates the video.
